question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**confiscated**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions that the Customs took action because the cases were considered merchandise.
 
• "**Confiscated**" means to seize or take away something, typically by authority, which fits the context of Customs holding the items.
 
• Other options ("**contributed**", "**concealed**", "**collected**") do not correctly convey the authoritative seizure of the items.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: He knew everyone on the island. Whenever his car stopped, half a dozen voices *would *__shout out his name. Policemen, agricultural labourers of low social status and priests waved and smiled __*____as___*__ he passed; everyone greeted him as a brother. They respected his honesty, and belligerence, and above all, they adored his typically Greek scorn and fearlessness when dealing with any __*form *__of Governmental red tape. On arrival, two of our cases containing linen and other things had been __***confiscated ***__by the Customs on the curious ground that they were merchandise. So, when we moved out to the villa and the problem of bed linen arose, Mother told Spiro ______ 5 _____ our cases in the Customs and asked for his advice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Contributed (योगदान किया): Means to give or supply something, not relevant in context of seizure by Customs.
 
• Concealed (छुपाया हुआ): Means hidden, not fitting the context of Customs' action.
 
• Collected (एकत्रित किया): Means gathered, but does not imply the authoritative action described.
